services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Sherwin Miller Museum of Jewish Art is seeking passionate volunteers to join our docent program. Click the button below to contact our staff about becoming a docent. Docents are at the heart of the Museum experience. As a docent, you'll help visitors connect with thousands of years of Jewish history, art, culture, and the lessons of the Holocaust through meaningful conversations and engaging tours.Whether welcoming school groups, sharing stories from our collections, or helping visitors see history from a new perspective, docents play an important role in fostering understanding and building community.
